v2.title: Innovation Oasis officially opens as Silal’s R&D and venture engine
v2.excerpt: A state-of-the-art center for agricultural research, innovation, validation and commercialization opens on 34 hectares beside Al Foah Farm, Al Ain.
v2.alt: Guests at the official inauguration of Innovation Oasis

v2.title: FoodTech Challenge winners recognised at Innovation Oasis
v2.excerpt: Startups developing technologies for arid-climate agriculture were recognised after a final round of pitches to partners and investors.

v2.title: Finalists pitch technologies built for the desert
v2.excerpt: From water efficiency to protected cultivation, finalists presented solutions designed to work under the pressures that define tomorrow’s food system.
v2.alt: A founder pitching to an audience during the final round

v2.title: Advanced Agritech Academy welcomes its first cohort
v2.excerpt: A new generation of agri-food talent begins hands-on training in laboratories, greenhouses and the field.
v2.alt: A trainee at the Advanced Agritech Academy

v2.title: New growth chambers come online for controlled-environment trials
v2.excerpt: Precisely controlled light, temperature and humidity let teams test crops against the conditions of tomorrow.
v2.alt: A researcher inspecting plants inside a growth chamber

v2.title: Soil-sensing trials begin in the field-testing areas
v2.excerpt: Sensors tested in real conditions help growers use every drop of water where it matters.
v2.alt: A soil sensor probe being tested at the base of a tree

v2.title: Drone-based crop monitoring tested across the trial plots
v2.excerpt: Aerial data gives researchers and farmers a shared view of every plot, every week.
v2.alt: An agricultural drone in flight over the site

v2.title: Hydroponic tomato trials begin in the greenhouses
v2.excerpt: Soilless systems are tested for yield and water use under the UAE’s toughest growing conditions.
v2.alt: A tomato seedling growing in a hydroponic system

v2.title: Partners tour the 34-hectare site
v2.excerpt: Researchers, farmers and industry partners walked the greenhouses and trial fields side-by-side.
